Maintainer.Profile:
Self-hosted apps for the home server, by Darkmatter5. Each one is open source, runs as a single container, keeps its data in appdata and supports multiple users with private data per account.
**Ledgerly** - personal finance. Bills with due dates and the account each is paid from, projected running balances, income, credit cards, and loans with full amortization tables.
**MeshVault** - a catalog for a 3D printing model collection. Indexes model folders in place, then adds search, tags, collections, designers, rendered thumbnails and an in-browser 3D preview.
For help or bug reports, open an issue on the GitHub project for the app you are using.
